gold: Pyomyositis of the levator scapulae muscle caused by Fusobacterium necrophorum

selector.rationale: The presence of a firm swelling in the posterior triangle of the left neck, torticollis, and imaging studies showing an intramuscular abscess in the left levator scapulae muscle support the diagnosis of Levator scapulae muscle abscess.

rejected.label: Fusobacterium necrophorum infection
rejected.why: While F necrophorum infection is present, it is not the primary diagnosis, but rather a cause of the abscess.

rejected.label: Parapharyngeal abscess
rejected.why: The location of the abscess is in the levator scapulae muscle, not in the parapharyngeal space.

rejected.label: Cervical lymphadenitis
rejected.why: The imaging studies show an abscess in the muscle, not lymphadenitis.
